description: We are doing the OTTAWA SPACE HARDWARE CHALLENGE. We are a group of 6.
summary: OTTAWA SPACE HARDWARE CHALLENGE. We developed folding and fan-shaped solar panels to protect them from sandstorms. The fan-shaped solar panels expand to maximize surface area in a compact space. We placed the solar panels on the rover.
details:
The rover is powered by an STM32 Microcontroller and four AA batteries. The rover deploys solar panels when light is detected by the four photoresistors. When the sandstorm is detected by changes in light intensity, the rover folds the solar panels to protect them from the sandstorm.

We developed the code in C++ and used crafting tools such as paper, wooden sticks, tape, and glue to assemble the rover.

The intended impact is to protect the solar panels and maximize surface area. The project is creative because it uses shapes to maximize surface area, reflecting our original ideas.
